faqs.q: What warranty applies to an India purchase?
faqs.a: Obtain model-specific written terms from the seller: warranty issuer, period, exclusions, serial-number region, claim route and labour/transport arrangements. A manufacturer product document alone does not establish coverage for a particular Indian sale.

description_text: Medequip’s manufacturer page lists Oxymed Mini flow at 1–5 L/min, weight 13.9 kg, sound 45 dB, power 390 W, and a 3-year warranty. Its concentration table says 90–96%, while page prose says 93% ±3%; its specification-table OPI/analyzer fields are blank. The same page states that this product is not a medical device and should not be used for medical treatment or life-support. Confirm intended medical-device status and applicable authorization before considering it for prescribed oxygen therapy.
